subject: Crosswalk onboarding: Pinecone / Weaviate integration ops & pilot
messages:
From: Dave Hart <dave.hart@pinecone.io>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + Crosswalk onboarding (Pinecone + Weaviate)

Hi Karthik / Vanessa / Ben —

Thanks for the quick intro, Laura. I'm Dave on the partner engineering team at Pinecone. We recently did a short proof-of-concept with Nebula Analytics and they asked if we could work with Redwood to pilot a crossstore routing flow (Pinecone primary, Weaviate fallback) that preserves embedding metadata and supports S3 cold tiering for older vectors.

High level ask: a 4-week pilot to validate routing logic, auth flow, and operational runbooks. We can bring a sandbox Pinecone index + test harness; Nebula will provide a stripped dataset.

Would you be available for a 30-min call this week to align scope and technical owners? Attached is a one-page onboarding checklist and a rough timeline.

Attachment: pinecone_onboarding_checklist.pdf (PDF)

Thanks —
Dave Hart
Partner Engineering, Pinecone
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Dave Hart <dave.hart@pinecone.io>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + Crosswalk onboarding (Pinecone + Weaviate)

Dave —

Appreciate the note. Redwood is interested in collaborating on a short pilot to exercise crossstore routing and the S3 cold lane. Proposed agenda for a kickoff call:

- Introductions & success criteria (10m)
- Data / auth & network options (10m)
- Pilot topology: sandbox indices, routing policy, and metrics (5m)
- Next steps / action owners (5m)

Available slots: Wed 2026-09-08 09:00–11:00 PT or Thu 2026-09-09 14:00–16:00 PT. Please pick a time or propose alternatives.

Looping in Vanessa and Ben to own operational questions and runbook inputs. I'm attaching our internal intake form to capture requirements (low-sensitivity dataset expected).

Attachment: internal_intake_form.docx (DOCX)

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Intro + Crosswalk onboarding (notes + ops questions)

Karthik / Ben —

Quick ops notes before we sync:

- Security: we'll need a data residency matrix from Nebula and confirmation that embeddings are non-PII. SOC2 evidence for Pinecone + Weaviate will be required for Dedicated/Private deals.
- Network: pref VPC peering or AWS PrivateLink for the pilot to avoid public endpoints; ask Pinecone for supported options in sandbox.
- Observability: must capture per-request routing metrics (origin store, fallback occurrence, latency) so we can validate cost/latency tradeoffs.
- Pilot infra ask: can we get a lightweight dedicated pool (1-2 GPUs) to reproduce real LLM workload? If not, we'll simulate token load.

I'll bring a short runbook template to the kickoff. Also flagging potential commercial asks: pricing for a 4-week pilot (credits vs bill) and an LOI placeholder.

-Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Partner Solutions
Redwood Inference

Hi everyone —

Thanks for pulling this together. Nebula is keen to run the pilot. A few quick confirmations from our end:

- Dataset: we'll deliver a pseudonymized 100k-rows embedding payload (no user identifiers).
- Goal: validate routing fidelity, cold tier retrieval latency (S3), and overall end-to-end cost for a QPS profile that approximates our production (peak 25 qps).
- Availability: Thu 2026-09-09 14:00–16:00 PT works for our engineering lead.
- Commercial: we'll sign an LOI prior to kickoff; can Redwood and Pinecone provide a pilot credit estimate so we can include it in the LOI?

I've attached a draft pilot scope and the access matrix mapping (who needs which cloud roles, temporary keys, and firewall IPs).

Attachments: crosswalk_pilot_scope.pdf (PDF), access_matrix.xlsx (XLSX)

Thanks —
Maya Singh
Head of Infrastructure, Nebula Analytics
